body:
### Summary

GMRES previously stopped before processing the current Hessenberg column when a Krylov breakdown occurred. On the first iteration, this could lead to an out-of-bounds access; on a later iteration, it could discard a column needed for convergence.

This change processes the final column before stopping, tracks the number of processed columns independently of the basis size, and reports a singular Krylov system instead of dividing by zero.

### Tests

- Added regressions for exact breakdown on the first and a later iteration, including checks of the actual residual.
- Added singular and near-breakdown tests that check the reported error.
- Confirmed the two exact-breakdown regressions fail with the original solver.
- Built the test target and ran the focused GMRES and existing solver tests successfully.
title: Fix handling of Krylov breakdown in GMRES
